note: Regression fixtures for the Table Path Finder 'most unique' ranking (v2, grill t_3bf36e2e). Schema: {id, source, target, maxHops, mode ('unique'|'shortest', default 'unique'), bar ('top-N' | 'existence'), mustSurface: [table-path arrays], mustNotSurface: [table-path arrays], classExpect: [{path, min?, max?}], asserts: [named checks], note}. Every mustSurface path is existence-validated against static/data/fk-map.json by tests/validate-fixtures.mjs. bar='top-N': every path in mustSurface must appear within the top-N results of the given mode; every path in mustNotSurface must NOT appear within the top-N. bar='existence': mustSurface paths must be valid chains (they power the fixture-driven canonical-path UI). classExpect asserts qualityClass bounds (min/max) on surfaced paths. Named asserts (tests/assert-fixtures.mjs): top10-not-single-subtree, top10-sane, top10-no-payment-noise, top5-taxposted-path (top-5 contains a TaxTrans-variant path ending at TaxTable, leaf wildcard), no-ghost-taxitemgroupdata (TaxItemGroupData must never appear in fk-map.json).

Pre-posting tax-resolution tripwire (re-baselined 2026-08-17 on fp 342774f9933f): the correct pre-posting answer for a sales line is the INTERSECTION of two legs — SalesLine.TaxGroup -> TaxGroupHeading -> TaxGroupData -> TaxTable and SalesLine.TaxItemGroup -> TaxItemGroupHeading -> TaxOnItem -> TaxTable (TaxOnItem is the real line table, key TaxItemGroup+TaxCode; the Google-derived 'TaxItemGroupData' name is a GHOST table in D365FO 10.0.2645.32). Existence bar: both chains must stay walkable in fk-map.json — this fixture fails loudly if the substrate regresses. Ranking is intentionally NOT asserted: both legs measured outside top-50 (TaxTable carries a generic -1 class cap, TaxGroupHeading is a 168-child hub). no-ghost-taxitemgroupdata guards the dataset/generator against reintroducing the hallucinated table. Posting state (recompute pre-posting vs read posted) is domain knowledge, not schema.
